correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact 2026 ratio feedback r=(B/A)(1-Ap)^2, differentiation yields a uniformly contractive four-map affine recursion with a strictly invariant interior interval. Stationary mean 1/mu and variance eta*nu*(nu-mu^2)/[mu^2(mu^2-eta*nu^2)] follow from independent fresh random slopes and innovations. The fresh-test factor is (nu-mu^2)/(mu^2-eta*nu^2), giving eta_c=4b/(1+b^2)^2 and unique curvature threshold from the quartic. Ergodic coupling plus truncated logarithms and Jensen proves limsup(n^-1 log|X_n/X_0|)<=log((b-1)/(b+1)) for all admissible gains. Independent rational calculations and the packaged standalone checker corroborate finite formulas and the b=10 witness; finite testing is not used for the infinite proof. The prospective factor is explicitly distinguished from the actual state mean-square rate.
